description: Award-worthy (Awwwards-level) main hub website for CELINA in La Seu d'Urgell, Spain. CELINA is a multi-service brand bringing together International Money Transfers (Ria, Western Union), Travel Agency, Jewelry/Bisutería, and Celina Studio (Web Design & Digital Marketing).

visual_enhancers.editorial_marquee: Very smooth low-speed drifting band with serif typography and understated green & navy accents.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis Smooth Scroll engine integrated globally.

framer_motion_patterns.hero_line_reveal: Staggered masked character/word reveal with 0.8s easeOut duration.

framer_motion_patterns.interactive_tabs: Framer Motion layoutId for fluid active bar indicator.

micro_interactions.cta_button: Scale 1.02 on hover, 0.98 on press, text shimmer on focus.

layout_and_grids.hero_layout: Asymmetric Split Hero — Left: Kinetic Editorial typography + CTA group; Right: Layered frame with real Mediterranean visual + floating 3D glass accent badges.

layout_and_grids.trust_grid: 4-column responsive grid with subtle card outline and hover highlight.
layout_and_grids.location_layout: Split layout — Left: La Seu d'Urgell details & interactive contact cards; Right: Custom interactive location card with styled map representation and real directions.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements, buttons, cards, links, tabs, and form inputs must have descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete implementation inside /app/frontend/src/ using high quality React components.
Ensure Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion are initialized for award-winning scroll feel.
Maintain strict adherence to the brand color palette (#0B235E primary navy, #04BE4F green action button accent, #F5F7FA background).
Include direct WhatsApp deep links (e.g., https://wa.me/34600000000?text=Hola%20Celina...) across all CTA buttons.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness and add a sticky floating WhatsApp button on bottom right with subtle pulse animation.
Add detailed interactive state dialogs for product details, transfer calculator, and studio audit request to make the site fully engaging.
